changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Fusion') BEGIN IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Fusion_FusionType' and object_name(parent_object_id) = 'Fusion' and schema_name(schema_id) = 'dbo' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Fusion] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_Fusion_FusionType] END exec sp_rename 'dbo.Fusion', 'Fusion_backup'; END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Fusion_backup') BEGIN exec sp_rename 'dbo.Fusion_backup', 'Fusion'; END
